role: Sharpen engine juror (senior X ghostwriter and copy chief)
verdict: On ordinary, everyday X drafts, v4.3's Claude path matches Typefully's AI rewrite on edit quality and beats it on safety and restraint. It scored 99.2% postable (98.6% on lines that need work) with 0 misses, 0 broken lines and 0 facts or meanings changed; it left 46/46 sharp lines and every deadpan label alone, kept number qualifiers ('like 3 years') and gave true receipts with three cosmetic slips. The on-device engine reaches 92.5% / 89.2% postable but introduces two typo-level breaks, which the homepage shows and the app's strict instant line flashes before Claude replaces them: 'it's... Not great.' and 'now and, the thing'. It also still cuts a deadpan 'Life update:' and one number qualifier, and its put-back can leave 'Just a quick tip founders:'.
to_95_ondevice: Fix the two new break shapes in both default and strict modes, and add them to the guards: never capitalise the word after an ellipsis that was mid-sentence in the draft (z-6), and when a cut span sits between a conjunction and a comma ('and if I'm being honest, the'), drop the comma with it (z-35).
Deadpan labels: keep 'Life update:' (and the rest of the list) when the body is one or more whole sentences, not only one (z-118).
Treat 'like', 'about' and '~' before a number as qualifiers the engine never cuts, as the Claude validator already does (z-80).
Put-back: when a label is put back, put back the reshape words its cut removed too ('Just a quick tip for founders:', z-58).
Coverage: 'one of the most common things I hear from X is that' -> colon (z-54), 'my honest advice would be to (just)' (z-72), and 'I just wanted to say how grateful I am' after a kept frame (z-107).

issues.area: On-device engine / homepage demo / app instant line
issues.where: core.js sharpenLine sentence-case tidy and cut-span punctuation (default and strict)
issues.problem: Two typo-level breaks on everyday lines, in both default and strict modes. The homepage shows them under 'What changed', and the app flashes them before Claude's line arrives: z-6 'I finally sat down and calculated my total trading P&L for the year and it's... Not great.' (capital after a mid-sentence ellipsis) and z-35 '…almost four years now and, the thing that I wish…' (stray comma left when 'if I'm being honest' is cut). No meaning changes, but a writing tool must not add typos. A pattern scan of all 600 lines from sets 1-5 finds only these two.
issues.fix: (1) In the sentence-start capitaliser, treat '...' and '…' as a sentence end only when the draft capitalised the next word. (2) When a cut span is followed by a comma and preceded by and/but/or, remove that comma too. Add both as strict rejects and to the page's gWhole.

issues.problem: z-118 'Life update: I own a sourdough starter now. It has a name. It has opinions.' loses its label; the v4.3 rule keeps labels only on a single whole sentence. z-80 cuts 'like' from 'after like 3 years', turning an approximation into an exact figure; the Claude path keeps it, and its validator's NQUAL list protects it.
issues.fix: Apply the deadpan keep to any body made of whole sentences. Drop the likeNum cut, or limit it to 'like' that isn't followed by a number.

issues.where: sharpenLine with keep: ['Just a quick tip']
issues.problem: z-58 Sharpen: 'Founders: you don't need to post every day…'. Putting back 'Just a quick tip' gives 'Just a quick tip founders: you don't need…' because the 'for' reshape stays cut.
issues.fix: When a kept span had reshape cuts attached (the 'for' in 'tip for founders'), restore them with it, or re-run without that reshape.

issues.where: slExplain move labels; the 'went too' appender
issues.problem: Cosmetic receipt slips on the Claude path: z-6 says 'Split it into three beats' for two sentences; z-21 repeats itself ('the stacked “i think” went … “and honestly i think” went too'); z-71 doesn't mention that 'Hot take but' became 'Hot take:'. On-device, z-6 and z-35 get 'It now opens on…' and 'the claim stands on its own' on lines the engine broke.
issues.fix: Count beats as sentences, not ellipsis or hashtag runs. Have the 'went too' appender skip spans already named. Add a 'Fixed the punctuation' fragment when a frame's joining word changed.

issues.problem: z-3: v1 restructures a thread opener into a longer, clunkier line ('Some thoughts on the $JUP tokenomics after spending the whole weekend going through them 🧵'), while the alt split is the post.
issues.fix: Prefer the split or light edit as v1 when the restructure isn't shorter than the draft.

issues.problem: As in every round, these Claude lines came from a stand-in at default effort, while production runs Opus 5.5 at low effort with a 12 s timeout. Timeout and cap rates decide how often users see the on-device line instead.
issues.fix: Before launch, re-run all 600 lines (sets 1-5) through sharpenClaude at production settings and report postable %, timeout, cap and rules rates.
